name: Rotary Autocannon
description: Rotary autocannons have a tremendous rate of fire, but can overheat quickly. Autocannons require electric power to load ammo from connected belts or drums.

logicNodes.label: Trigger
logicNodes.description: When true: feeds, loads, and fires cartridges from a connected belt or drum.

logicNodes.label: Loaded
logicNodes.description: Returns true when a cartridge is loaded and ready to fire.
